AI travel planner

Applied AI

A multi-agent planner built with LangGraph. Flight, hotel, activity, transportation and budget agents draft the itinerary together. When projected costs run over budget, the budget agent proposes cheaper options that keep the traveler’s priorities.

  2. Planned activities
  3. Budget check
  4. Adjusted itinerary

Real-time graph analytics

Streaming data

Streams New York City taxi trips through Kafka into a Neo4j graph as they arrive. PageRank ranks the most connected locations, and breadth-first search traces paths between them.

  2. Kafka stream
  3. Neo4j graph
  4. PageRank + BFS
